page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.u2i server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz, utilizing KVM virtualization. The instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, which establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory allocated per core.

This server configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance. The server does not feature any GPU acceleration, making it unsuitable for workloads requiring hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a standard general-purpose resource density makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without the overhead of burstable models. Appropriate workloads include mid-sized web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and general-purpose business applications that require a balanced distribution of compute and memory resources.
